li-ning-axforce-90: Fast and snappy with easy clears; the sweet spot is small.
li-ning-halbertec-9000: Soft, forgiving and easy to swing; limited smash power.
victor-auraspeed-100x-ultra: Fast and agile for drives and defence; short on smash power.
victor-auraspeed-90k-metallic: Fast and solid, but the very stiff shaft demands technique.
victor-auraspeed-fantome: Very fast and good in defence; stiff enough to tire the forearm.
victor-auraspeed-hs-plus: Very fast doubles defence; stiff and demanding.
victor-drivex-10-metallic: Easy smash power for hard hitters; stiff and demanding.
victor-drivex-12: Excellent control for mid and back court; sluggish for some.
victor-thruster-f-c-ultra: Effortless power and a quick swing; a few mention vibration.
victor-thruster-ryuga-ii-pro: Stable with easy power; slow to swing and stiff for some.
victor-thruster-ryuga-metallic: Big smash power and stability; slow in fast doubles defence.
yonex-arcsaber-11-play: Control and comfort at a modest price; limited smash power.
yonex-arcsaber-11-pro: Outstanding control for doubles; weak smashes and clears.
yonex-arcsaber-7-pro: Easy, forgiving control for doubles; lacks smash power.
yonex-astrox-77-pro: Friendly step into head-heavy power; slow through the air.
yonex-astrox-88-d-pro: Effortless smashes and clears; slower drives, tiring shoulder.
yonex-astrox-88-s-pro: Sharp, fast front-court play; less smash power for singles.
yonex-astrox-nextage: Forgiving with a big sweet spot; too flexible for a few.
yonex-nanoflare-1000-z: Fast and crisp, but many frames cracked without hard clashes.
yonex-nanoflare-800-pro: Very fast and forgiving; several frames broke.
